name: Transport, aircraft; freight
description: This cradle-to-gate unit process is for the transport of 1 tonne of freight 1 kilometer via freight aircraft. This data is from The Greenhouse Gases, Regulated Emissions, and Energy Use in Transportation 2023 Model (GREET).
category: 48-49: Transportation and Warehousing/4811: Scheduled Air Transportation

processDocumentation.timeDescription: This unit process is representative of 2010 emissions data and 2021 average trip distance and fuel consumption data.
processDocumentation.geographyDescription: This process is representative of aircraft freight transport in the United States.
processDocumentation.technologyDescription: This data represents the combustion of fuel in a large quad freight aircraft.
processDocumentation.modelingConstantsDescription: This process was adapted from GREET, 2023.
processDocumentation.completenessDescription:
TREATMENT OF MISSING ENVIRONMENTAL DATA: Unknown. Refer to GREET, 2023

TREATMENT OF MISSING TECHNOSPHERE DATA: Unknown. Refer to GREET, 2023

MASS BALANCE: Unknown. Refer to GREET, 2023
processDocumentation.dataSelectionDescription: This dataset was sourced from GREET, 2023. No data was excluded.
processDocumentation.samplingDescription:
BOUNDARY CONDITIONS: Pump to wheel, includes combustion emissions

DATA COLLECTION: GREET emissions data is from the US Department of Transportation Volpe Center and the AAFEX-1 CFM56-2C1 study.  And average trip distance and fuel consumption data is from the US Department of Transportation Bureau of Labor Statistics.

UNCERTAINTY ESTIMATION: Unknown. Refer to GREET, 2023
processDocumentation.dataCollectionDescription: Emissions data in GREET is from 2010 and average trip distance and fuel consumption data is from 2021.
processDocumentation.intendedApplication: The intended application for this process is for accounting purposes as described in Goal Situation C1 from the ILCD Handbook's Detailed Guidance. LCA studies with this intended application offer "purely descriptive documentation of the system under analysis (e.g., a product, sector or country), without being interested in any potential consequences on other parts of the economy.” The studies categorized under Goal Situation C1 do consider existing benefits outside the analyzed system such as recycling. These data are an update to a previously published dataset.
